notes: "This is the editor itself, running a small public example. 1, the sidebar has four tabs: Project, Pages, Assets, and Files, which shows the project folder the way VS Code shows a code repository. Assets is a real library: every figure in the project, with its original size and where it is used. 2, the views above the canvas: Normal, Browse, Outline, Sections, Notes page and History. 3, the canvas edits native objects, including tables and charts. 4, the Inspector: properties, layout, a Layers panel in the spirit of Photoshop, the Story of the slide, and checks. 5, Agent setup connects the AI client you already use, and Activity shows what it reports and what was actually saved. 6, Export and Present. There is no chat box inside the editor."
